summary: The screen shows 12 BUY names, but all six dossiers say WATCH or TOO HARD because the screen's prices rest on stale growth, trailing earnings or lender cash flow. Nothing is at tranche 1; LULU is closest at $94.50 vs $90, and KNSL reports on 22 Oct. The Professor found no major issues and added two lessons on lenders and guidance cuts.
